name: gtrk
description: Agent-native video creation: turn your own footage into an editable multi-track project (talking-head cuts, highlights, narration, B-roll, motion graphics, captions) and export to Jianying/CapCut, Premiere XML, FCPXML or OTIO. Requires the gtrk CLI (npm @gitruck/cli).

interface.longDescription: Turn your own footage into an editable multi-track project (talking-head cuts, highlights, narration, B-roll, motion graphics, captions) and export to Jianying/CapCut, Premiere XML, FCPXML or OTIO. The plugin ships the Skills only: install the gtrk CLI and set an API key with `npx -y @gitruck/cli@latest install`. Cloud steps run on Gitruck Cloud and are billed in credits. Skill instructions are written in Chinese.
defaultPrompt: Turn “talk.mp4” into a video. The script is in the same folder. Show me the production plan first.
Cut this talking-head recording, remove retakes and long pauses, and give me a project I can keep editing.
Transcribe “interview.mp4” into a timestamped transcript with a summary.
